# Surah 113: map of image chains

## Chains

### 1. Night coming in, daybreak splitting it away
Night darkens from dusk to its thickest and pours down over the hills. The sun goes into its place and the dark comes in on people (وَقَبَ). Daybreak is that same darkness split away from the light it covered. The surah opens with the Lord of that splitting (ٱلْفَلَقِ) and names the entering dark (غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ) two ayat later. One movement is darkness entering, the other is darkness split off. The listener hears the night of 113:3 inside a day the Lord of 113:1 opens. Starts from HFT: counter ingress, threshold concealment, opening reverses enclosure, state triggered ingress, ingress threshold.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B002 — «الفلق الصبح لأن الظلام ينفلق عنه» (maqayis); «الصبح والله فلقه أي أوضحه وأبداه فانفلق» (ayn) — daybreak is the darkness splitting off, and God is the one who splits it and makes the morning plain.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B002 — «الفلق بيان الحق بعد إشكال» (tahdhib) — the same splitting carried over to truth becoming clear after confusion.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B001 — «الفلق شق الشيء وإبانة بعضه عن بعض» (mufradat) — the operation itself: one part cut away from another.
- 113:3 غَاسِقٍ — غ س ق B001 — «الغاسق الليل إذا غاب الشفق» (ayn;sihah;tahdhib); «الغسق أول ظلمة الليل» (sihah;tahdhib); «غسق الليل شدة ظلمته» (mufradat) — night from the moment the afterglow goes, through its first dark, to its thickest.
- 113:3 غَاسِقٍ — غ س ق B004 — «غسق الليل على الظراب أي انصب الليل على الجبال» (tahdhib) — night pours down onto the hills like a liquid.
- 113:3 وَقَبَ — و ق ب B002 — «وقبت الشمس إذا غابت ودخلت موضعها ووقب الظلام دخل على الناس» (sihah); «إذا وقب إذا دخل في كل شيء أو ظلم» (tahdhib) — the sun goes into its place, and the dark comes in on people and gets into everything.
- 113:3 غَاسِقٍ — غ س ق B003 [fixed expression] — «غسقت عينه أظلمت» (maqayis;sihah) — the dark reaches the eye.
- Quran: 6:96 (God described among His signs, continuing 6:95): فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ سَكَنًۭا, with وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ. The splitter of morning sets the night as rest.
- Quran: 17:78 (God commands the Prophet to pray): لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ. One command runs from the sun's decline to the night's غسق and then to the dawn recitation.
- Quran: 2:187 (rules of the fast night): حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ ٱلْخَيْطُ ٱلْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْطِ ٱلْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ ٱلْفَجْرِ. Dawn is a white thread separating from a black one.
- Quran: 81:17–18, 74:33–34, 92:1–2 (oaths): the night's onset or retreat is paired with the morning breathing out, shining or appearing.
- Quran: 79:29 (God's making of the sky): وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا. The night is darkened and the forenoon brought out.
- Quran: 13:3 (God's signs): يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ.
- Quran: 18:86 (Dhu l-Qarnayn reaching the sunset): وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍۢ. This stages the sun "going into its place" of the وقب phrase.
- Quran: 26:52, 26:60–63 (Moses and Israel; the scene opens at 26:52 with the command أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ, a journey by night). Pharaoh's host follows them مُّشْرِقِينَ, at sunrise. Moses says إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ, and the sea فَٱنفَلَقَ.

### 2. Split open and brought out: seed, morning, all creation
The splitting of الفلق does more than separate. It brings out what was enclosed (the plant from the seed, the morning from the dark) and makes it visible. The dictionary names the whole of creation by this act: «الفلق الخلق كله». That phrase joins the epithet of 113:1 to the مَا خَلَقَ of 113:2. In this chain, "what He created" is everything split out and shown. One branch of شَرّ is itself "to bring out and show" (أشررت). The maqayis gives شَرّ the same pair of verbs it uses for الفلق (أبرز, أظهر). Speech is defined the same way: inner meaning brought out by the tongue. So the commanded قُلْ belongs to this movement as well. Starts from HFT: generative emergence, created field discrimination, harm as disclosure, and the growth members of preserved growth and reparative opening.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B003 — «والله يفلق الحب فينفلق عن نباته» (ayn); «فالق الحب والنوى» (tahdhib;mufradat) — the seed split so that its plant comes out.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B003 — «الفلق الخلق كله كأنه شيء فلق عنه شيء حتى أبرز وأظهر» (maqayis); «يقال الفلق الخلق كله» (sihah;tahdhib) — the dictionary itself equates الفلق with الخلق: every created thing is something split out of something else until it is brought out and shown.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B001 — «الفليق ضرب من الخوخ يتفلق عن نواه» (sihah) — a peach that splits away from its stone: the object scale of the act.
- 113:2 خَلَقَ — خ ل ق B002 — «يستعمل في إبداع الشيء من غير أصل ولا احتذاء؛ ويستعمل في إيجاد الشيء من الشيء» (mufradat) — bringing a thing into being from another thing, which is the split of B003.
- 113:2 خَلَقَ — خ ل ق B003 — «مخلقة قد بدا خلقها وغير مخلقة لم تصور» (tahdhib) — the form that has appeared as against the one not yet shaped.
- 113:2 شَرِّ — ش ر ر B008 — «أشررت الشيء إذا أبرزته وأظهرته» (maqayis); «أشررت الشيء أظهرته» (sihah) — to bring out and make visible, with the same verbs as the maqayis phrase for الفلق.
- 113:1 بِرَبِّ — ر ب ب B002 — «التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام» (mufradat) — what is brought out is then raised stage by stage until complete.
- 113:1 قُلْ — ق و ل B001 — «المركب من الحروف المبرز بالنطق» (mufradat) — speech is letters brought out (المبرز) by utterance.
- 113:1 قُلْ — ق و ل B012 [fixed expression] — «المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ قول» (mufradat) — before it comes out, speech is held inside.
- Quran: 6:95 (God described): إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلْحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ ۖ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ. The split is the bringing out. 6:96 follows with فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ.
- Quran: 80:25–27 (God recounting provision to man): صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا.
- Quran: 86:11–12 (oath): وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ, the earth that cracks open for plants.
- Quran: 2:74 (God to Israel about hardened hearts): وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمَآءُ. Even a stone splits and water comes out.
- Quran: 22:5 (God to people in doubt of the resurrection): مُّضْغَةٍۢ مُّخَلَّقَةٍۢ وَغَيْرِ مُّخَلَّقَةٍۢ … ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا. The formed embryo is brought out.

### 3. Rain: cloud, drizzle, low ground, rock hollows
The lexicon of the surah's words holds a whole rain scene. A cloud hangs low and lingers. It is split with rain, the sky drizzles, and the water runs down into the low ground between two rises. It gathers in hollows of smooth rock, in a hollow on the mountain, or as a great body of water. Or the valley closes over a people and destroys them. Two of the surah's words have nearly the same dictionary phrase for the rock hollow that holds rain: الوقب (113:3) and الخليقة (113:2). وَقَبَ, "it entered a hollow", is the water's movement into that hollow. Starts from HFT: cloud into pass, receptacle flow topology, permeability and repair, hydraulic ingress (its شَرّ "basin-filling" member is the echo ش ر ي B010 and is not carried), governed breach.
- 113:1 بِرَبِّ — ر ب ب B008 — «الرباب: السحاب، سمي بذلك لأنه يرب النبات» (mufradat); «السحاب المتعلق دون السحاب يكون أبيض ويكون أسود» (maqayis) — the low-hanging cloud, named for nurturing the plants.
- 113:1 بِرَبِّ — ر ب ب B007 — «أربت السحابة: دامت» (mufradat) — the cloud stays.
- 113:2 خَلَقَ — خ ل ق B008 — «اخلولق السحاب استوى» (maqayis); «الخلقة السحابة المستوية» (tahdhib) — the cloud spreads level.
- 113:4 ٱلْعُقَدِ — ع ق د B008 [fixed expression] — «تعقد السحاب إذا صار كأنه عقد مضروب مبني» (ayn;maqayis) — the cloud masses like a built arch.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B003 — «فلق الأرض بالنبات والسحاب بالمطر» (tahdhib) — the cloud is split with rain, as the earth is split with plants.
- 113:3 غَاسِقٍ — غ س ق B004 — «غسقت السماء أرشت» (tahdhib); «الغاسق بمعنى السائل» (tahdhib) — the sky drizzles, and the غاسق is "the one that flows".
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B004 — «الفلق المطمئن من الأرض بين الربوتين» (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat); «كان ذلك بفالق كذا للمنحدر بين ربوتين» (sihah;tahdhib) — the low ground and slope between two rises, where water runs.
- 113:4 ٱلْعُقَدِ — ع ق د B008 [fixed expression] — «العقد ترطب الرمل من كثرة المطر» (tahdhib) — sand soaked by heavy rain.
- 113:3 وَقَبَ — و ق ب B001 — «الوقب في الجبل نقرة يجتمع فيها الماء ووقب العين نقرتها» (sihah); «كل قلت أو حفرة» (ayn;tahdhib) — the mountain hollow where water gathers.
- 113:3 وَقَبَ — و ق ب B002 — «وقب الشيء دخل في وقبة» (maqayis;mufradat) — the entering into that hollow.
- 113:2 خَلَقَ — خ ل ق B011 — «الخليقة نقر في صخرة يجتمع فيه ماء السماء» (jamhara); «قلاتا تمسك ماء السحاب في صفاة خلقها الله فيها تسميها العرب الخلائق» (tahdhib) — the same rock hollow holding sky-water, here named by the root of خَلَقَ.
- 113:2 خَلَقَ — خ ل ق B008 — «صخرة خلقاء أي ملساء» (maqayis) — the smooth rock in which such hollows sit.
- 113:1 بِرَبِّ — ر ب ب B013 — «الربب وهو الماء الكثير سمي بذلك لاجتماعه» (maqayis) — abundant water, named for its gathering.
- 113:4 ٱلْعُقَدِ — ع ق د B016 — «إذا أطبق الوادي على قوم فأهلكهم عقد عليهم» (maqayis) — the reversal: the valley closes over a people.
- Quran: 24:43 (God's signs): يُزْجِى سَحَابًۭا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَامًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ. The cloud is massed, and rain comes out of its gaps.
- Quran: 13:17 (a parable of truth and falsehood): أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌۢ بِقَدَرِهَا. Each valley runs by its measure.
- Quran: 80:25–26 (as in chain 2): water poured, then the earth split.

### 4. Ends joined and parts split: the knot and the cleft
Al-Mufradat defines the two acts with matching words. عقد is «الجمع بين أطراف الشيء», joining a thing's ends. فلق is «شق الشيء وإبانة بعضه عن بعض», splitting a thing and parting its pieces. The surah opens with the Lord whose act is splitting and reaches the women who tie knots in threads and blow on them. One form of the root of الفلق, the jailer's split beam, is itself a binding device. The knot root also has the knot of anger and the knot of the tongue, both undone by "loosening". Starts from HFT: ritual binding, counter speech unbinding, spoken counterbinding, vented conviction (its anger-knot member).
- 113:4 ٱلْعُقَدِ — ع ق د B001 — «العقد الجمع بين أطراف الشيء» (mufradat); «عقدت الحبل أعقده عقدا وقد انعقد» (maqayis) — the ends of a rope drawn together and tied.
- 113:1 ٱلْفَلَقِ — ف ل ق B001 — «الفلق شق الشيء وإبانة بعضه عن بعض» (mufradat); «أصل صحيح يدل على فرجة وبينونة في الشيء» (maqayis) — the opposite act: a gap and a parting in the thing.
- 113:4 ٱلْعُقَدِ — ع ق د B013 — «النفاثات في العقد من السواحر اللواتي يعقدن في الخيوط» (maqayis); «المعقد الساحر» (maqayis); «أصله من العزيمة ولذلك يقال لها عزيمة كما يقال لها عقدة» (mufradat) — the sorceresses tie knots in threads, and the spell itself is called a knot.

### 5. Mouth against mouth: the commanded refuge and the blowing on knots
